docs(analytics): PostHog dashboard build pack + idempotent build runner (WIC-1024)

insights (A1-A9, B1-B5, C1-C3) are authored as HogQL and validated against live
project 551963 — 17/17 execute green, with real computed values (not nulls) from

has no insight:*/dashboard:* scope on project 551963. The runner's preflight

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Frontend Developer
Message:
feat(api): add user_id multi-tenancy schema and Supabase migration (WIC-196)

- Add 0011_add_user_id_multi_tenancy.sql Drizzle migration: user_id UUID
  nullable columns and indexes on all 19 user-owned tables
- Add supabase/migrations/0001_rls_user_isolation.sql: FK to auth.users
  and Row-Level Security policies (Supabase-only, not applied locally)
- Update Drizzle schema.ts: userId field on all tables
- Update db/client.ts: auto-detect Supabase URL and enable SSL
- Update config.ts: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET
- Update application.service.ts: all functions accept optional userId and
  scope queries when provided (backward-compat with local dev)
- Update resume.service.ts: uploadResume, listResumes, listResumeExports,
  getResumeExport, deleteResume all accept optional userId

Co-Authored-By: Paperclip <noreply@paperclip.ing>
_rationale: FALSE POSITIVE - not a credential. Value is the PUBLIC JWT header only: `eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9` decodes to {"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"} and is followed by a literal `...` truncation marker. Payload and signature segments are absent, so the token is unusable by construction and identical for every HS256 JWT ever issued. Documentation placeholder. Re-verified unredacted 2026-08-19 (WIC-1115).
_resolved: FALSE POSITIVE - no credential present, no remediation required
